21/05/2025.report: H Bowman, the rider of 5th placegetter, MIGHTY COMMANDER, pleaded guilty to a charge under Rule 100(2) in that he failed to ride his mount out to the end of the race to the satisfaction of the Stewards. H Bowman was suspended from riding in races for a period to commence on Saturday, 28 June 2025 and to expire on Wednesday, 2 July 2025 on which day he may resume race riding (2 Hong Kong racedays). In assessing penalty the Stewards were satisfied that his actions had compromised the horse’s finishing position. When questioned H Bowman stated that the intention was to hold a more forward position but his mount was bumped at the start and as a result he elected to obtain a trailing position behind JUMBO FORTUNE. He added that in the early stages MIGHTY COMMANDER raced keenly and approaching the 1000 Metres got its head up when being steadied away from SIMPLE HEDGE. After the race an endoscopic examination was conducted on MIGHTY COMMANDER at the request of Trainer C Fownes. Before being allowed to race again, MIGHTY COMMANDER will be subjected to an official veterinary examination. Sent for sampling post-race.

29/03/2026.report: Near the 250 Metres became unbalanced when it made contact with SERANGOON due to both runners shifting ground. When questioned regarding his riding in the early stages and the reason he made a forward move from the 1500 Metres when the early stages of the event were being run inside of standard time A Atzeni stated that he was given the instructions to go forward and as the race appeared to lack pace he was also given the option of leading if circumstances permitted. He said after being crossed by FORTUNE KINGO and GREY CHARGER in the early stages he held a position behind those two runners. He said near the 1500 Metres he felt the pace eased, particularly when R Kingscote, rider of GREY CHARGER, restrained his mount. He said as a consequence this resulted in STORM RUNNER racing keenly at which point he elected to shift out near the 1500 Metres to go forward. He added that as he then continued forward to cross FORTUNE KINGO and GREY CHARGER those two runners held their position which resulted in him having to make more use of his mount along the Back Straight where he was able to cross GREY CHARGER near the 1200 Metres. He said due to the manner in which he was obliged to ride his mount in the middle stages to cross GREY CHARGER, STORM RUNNER was left without a finishing effort in the Home Straight. Trainer P C Ng confirmed the instructions issued. He stated that whilst his preference would have been for STORM RUNNER to maintain its position with cover near the 1500 Metres he accepted Jockey Atzeni’s explanation as to why he elected to shift out and start a forward move. After considering his explanation the Stewards advised Jockey Atzeni that, having regard to the early stages of the event being run inside of standard time, he made an error of judgement by not making more effort to remain racing behind GREY CHARGER to avoid having to make too much use of his mount to cross the early leaders. A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings. The performance of STORM RUNNER was considered disappointing as compared to its previous race starts. HK_2023_J267.last_stewards_comment: Began awkwardly. From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages. An inquiry into the reasons for SUPREME AGILITY being checked near the 350 Metres was adjourned until the Happy Valley racemeeting on Sunday, 1 November 2026. Approaching the 100 Metres shifted to the inside of ALL ROUND WINNER to continue into clear running. Over the concluding stages could not be ridden out when MIGHTY STEED shifted out. <1/11/2026 Adjourned Inquiry – 28 October 2026 Sha Tin Racemeeting - Race 9 (147)>C L Chau (LUCKY SAM GOR) was found guilty of a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that near the 350 Metres he permitted his mount to shift out when insufficiently clear of SUPREME AGILITY, resulting in SUPREME AGILITY being checked and losing its rightful running when crowded between LUCKY SAM GOR and DRAGON AIR FORCE. C L Chau was suspended from riding in races for a period to commence on Saturday, 14 November 2026 and to expire on Thursday, 19 November 2026 on which day he may resume race riding (2 Hong Kong racedays). In addition, Jockey Chau was fined $60,000. In assessing penalty, the Stewards determined the carelessness grade 2 and the consequences grade 2 and also considered his neutral race riding record.

25/03/2026.report: Bumped after travelling a short distance. When questioned J Orman stated that he was asked to go forward but obtain cover if possible. He said in the early stages, after commencing well, he was obliged to allow his mount to continue forward to cross DASHING PAL and SUPER SICARIO which resulted in ANOTHER ZONDA being positioned outside the leader FRANTANCK. He added approaching the 1100 Metres ANOTHER ZONDA, which was racing keenly, improved past FRANTANCK and when its rider did not contest the lead he elected to continue forward to cross FRANTANCK after entering the Back Straight near the 900 Metres. When questioned if there was an opportunity to maintain a position to the outside of FRANTANCK to avoid setting a faster pace J Orman stated that as his mount was racing keenly and he had improved past FRANTANCK he felt that his mount’s best opportunity was to continue forward and cross that runner rather than having to continually restrain his mount. He further stated that after improving to the lead he was able to reduce the pace through the middle stages of the event in an attempt to assist his mount to finish off in the Home Straight but ANOTHER ZONDA failed to respond to his riding. Trainer Y S Tsui confirmed the preference was to obtain cover. A veterinary inspection immediately following the race which included an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse’s trachea. Before being allowed to race again, ANOTHER ZONDA will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
